summary: Scan widget configuration. Required to use the Scan widget. References positioners with forScanning=true.

fields.label: Scan cloak
fields.tip: Optional simplified frontend; must support the selected scan widget type.

fields.label: Scan designer
fields.tip: Class that builds the scan trajectory. Every panel but Expert needs one; the Expert panel compiles its own programs and leaves it null.

fields.label: Scan designer params
fields.tip: JSON dict passed to the scan designer ("{}" for none).

fields.label: TTL cycle designer
fields.tip: Class that emits the TTL pattern in sync with the scan; null for the Expert panel.

fields.label: Sample rate (Hz)
fields.tip: The waveform sample rate: the analog and digital waveforms are built and played at it, and every dwell is a whole number of its samples (the pixel rate is this over the samples per pixel). 100000 is what every setup ran at; other rates are played from the board's 100 MHz timebase divided down, within what the driver reports for each task, and must divide nidaq.detectionRateHz. A 1 µs pixel needs 1000000.

fields.label: Scan engine
fields.tip: The scan engine the Scan panel runs on: a name from scanEngines. null runs it on the NI-DAQ.

fields.label: Max scan time (min)
fields.tip: Hard cap on scan duration. null = no limit.

fields.label: Line clock line
fields.tip: Digital line for line-clock output, e.g. Dev1/port0/line6. null if unused.

fields.label: Frame start clock
fields.tip: Digital line for frame-start clock output. null if unused.

fields.label: Frame end clock
fields.tip: Digital line for frame-end clock output. null if unused.

simplePointScan.label: Objective NA
simplePointScan.tip: Objective numerical aperture used to derive the default Nyquist pixel size when no explicit override is set. Leave blank if unknown.

simplePointScan.label: Nyquist pixel size override (µm)
simplePointScan.tip: Optional explicit Nyquist pixel size in µm. When set, it takes precedence over Objective NA.

simplePointScan.label: Overview field (µm)
simplePointScan.tip: Preferred field of view for the coarse overview scan.

simplePointScan.label: Overview target time (s)
simplePointScan.tip: Target duration used when planning the coarse overview scan.

simplePointScan.label: Minimum samples / pixel
simplePointScan.tip: Minimum DAQ samples allocated to one overview pixel.

simplePointScan.label: Maximum dwell (ms)
simplePointScan.tip: Upper bound on the dwell time offered by the simplified point-scan panel.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: FOV source
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Use the detector ROI/pixel size for the current FOV, or use the configured manual FOV.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Manual / fallback FOV (µm)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: X × Y FOV in µm. Used directly in Manual mode and retained as the fallback value for detector-derived FOV.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: uLens period policy
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Use one setup-wide uLens period or require each profile to define its own period.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Fixed uLens period (µm)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Setup-wide uLens period used when the policy is fixed.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Default camera readout (ms)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Camera readout gap inherited by profiles that do not define their own cameraReadoutTimeMs.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Inter-pulse delay (ms)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Delay inserted between consecutive MoNaLISA sequence pulses.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: READOUT pulse (ms)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Duration of every semantic READOUT illumination step. Runtime enforces a minimum of 1 ms.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Default scan type
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Scan type selected when the SimpleMoNaLISA panel initializes.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Default pixel size (µm)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Default lateral sampling step / pixel size in µm.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Default Z step (µm)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Default axial sampling step in µm.

simpleMoNaLISA.label: Default Z range (µm)
simpleMoNaLISA.tip: Default axial scan range in µm.
